findings.claim: Deleting evalhandle/setcontent/addscript/addinitscript/addstyle/expose from ACTION_CATEGORIES and DOCUMENTED_ACTIONS leaves arbitrary JS execution reachable under deny:["eval"] via the daemon socket.
findings.evidence: Live daemon with deny:[eval]: evaluate DENIED; evalhandle and setcontent ALLOWED and mutated document.title to PWNED_EVALHANDLE / PWNED_SETCONTENT; addscript, addinitscript, expose ALLOWED.
findings.layer: end-to-end daemon socket against real Chrome

findings.claim: cdp_url is a complete policy escape, not a metadata read.
findings.evidence: Harvested cdpUrl from a daemon running deny:[eval]; attached a second unpoliced agent-browser via --cdp and executed document.title='ESCAPED_VIA_CDP_URL'; the policed daemon's own content shows the mutated title.
deny:[fill,click,interact]: fill DENIED; setvalue ALLOWED and wrote PWNED_SETVALUE; clear ALLOWED and emptied the field; dispatch click ALLOWED.

findings.claim: content is an uncategorized full-DOM read that escapes every read category.
findings.evidence: deny:[read,get,snapshot,network,state,eval]: read/gettext/snapshot DENIED; content ALLOWED and returned full page HTML including input values.

findings.claim: The coverage test has no teeth against new actions: it is keyed on DOCUMENTED_ACTIONS, which nothing forces a new dispatch arm to join.
findings.evidence: Set diff shows 25 live dispatch arms absent from DOCUMENTED_ACTIONS; no reverse-direction test exists (grep: DOCUMENTED_ACTIONS used only at :244, :250, :460).

findings.claim: Uncategorized find and inspect leak page text; trace_start/permissions/offline mutate state, all invisible to denylist policies.
findings.evidence: Under deny:[read,get,snapshot,...]: find returned element text STATUS_OK; inspect, permissions, offline, trace_start ALLOWED.
window_new is ALLOWED under deny:[navigate], but handle_window_new (actions.rs:9139-9146) creates the target at about:blank and ignores the url param; a follow-up navigate is still checked.

findings.claim: Round-1 F1 (find subaction bypass) is fixed.
findings.evidence: find label Secret fill pwned under deny:[fill] -> denied; get value #s still 'untouched'; find label Secret text and find label Secret click still permitted.

findings.claim: Round-1 F2 (wait --fn eval bypass) is fixed.
findings.evidence: wait --fn under deny:[eval] -> denied as waitforfunction; plain eval denied; plain wait 50 still allowed.

findings.claim: Round-1 F4/F5/F6 recategorizations hold at dispatch.
findings.evidence: Under a category denylist: mousedown, press, inserttext, pushstate, removeinitscript, cookies_get, credentials_list all denied.

findings.claim: Confirmation keying does not leak across a category and requires_confirmation does not diverge from check.
findings.evidence: Both call the same action_matches (policy.rs:148, :199); handle_confirm stores the concrete pending.action and restores the previous set after the single re-execution (actions.rs:10655-10664).

exemptions.claim: Allowlist policies are unaffected by the uncategorized allowlist.
exemptions.evidence: Under {default:deny, allow:[navigate,snapshot,click,scroll,wait,get]} every probed uncategorized action (cdp_url, content, responsebody, permissions, setcontent, evalhandle, addinitscript) was denied as 'not in the allow list'.

exemptions.claim: The MCP path is not an extra bypass surface for the deleted actions.
exemptions.evidence: cli/src/mcp.rs builds CLI argv strings (e.g. call_one_string(arguments, "auth login", "name")) and routes through the same parser, which rejects these verbs as Unknown command.

exemptions.claim: Category matching stays narrow for exact names.
exemptions.evidence: deny:[evalhandle] denies only evalhandle; evaluate and addscript remain Allow (policy.rs test at :391).

issue_candidates.title: README.md:486 and docs/src/app/init-scripts/page.mdx:32 document `agent-browser addinitscript <js>` but the CLI parser has no arm for it (commands.rs:2016 UnknownCommand).
issue_candidates.evidence: grep found addinitscript in README, init-scripts docs and skill-data/core/references/commands.md; no parse arm exists; the action is reachable only over the daemon socket.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: Pre-existing docs/parser drift; this diff neither created nor was asked to fix it, though it is the reason the writer read the action as dead.

issue_candidates.title: Duplicate/alias dispatch arms: useragent vs user_agent, emulatemedia vs set_media.
issue_candidates.evidence: Dispatch set diff lists useragent and emulatemedia as live arms absent from DOCUMENTED_ACTIONS while user_agent and set_media are documented.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: Pre-existing naming drift, not a policy defect on its own.

issue_candidates.title: UNCATEGORIZED_ACTIONS is not itself validated: `inspect` and `session_info` are listed there but absent from DOCUMENTED_ACTIONS, so those entries are never exercised.
issue_candidates.evidence: The coverage test only checks DOCUMENTED_ACTIONS members against the allowlist; extra allowlist entries are inert.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: Hygiene of the new test rather than a reachable bypass; folded into R2-5 as a mechanism note.
